info.title: MassGIS Spatial Data API
info.description: Programmatic access to MassGIS layers through MCP tools: search, schema, spatial queries, municipal filters, metadata, and MassMapper visualisation.

Full‑text keyword search across layer titles, descriptions, and indexed terms.

Workflow: Always call describe-schema immediately after picking a layer so you use exact column names in subsequent ECQL filters.

post.description:
Fetches and returns the attribute/column list for a chosen layer.

CRITICAL: Run this before any spatial queries. Never assume column names. Use the exact field names returned here (quote identifiers on the left-hand side in ECQL).

200.description: Markdown table of fields and types.

post.description:
PRIMARY TOOL for ECQL spatial predicates (INTERSECTS, DWITHIN, WITHIN, CONTAINS, TOUCHES, CROSSES, BEYOND).

CRITICAL: Do NOT use SQL SELECT inside ECQL. GeoServer ECQL does not support SQL subqueries.

Use ONLY the cross-layer pattern:
DWITHIN(target_geom, collectGeometries(queryCollection('layer','geom_col','filter')), distance, meters)
For a single feature, use querySingle(...). Quote bare identifiers on the LHS, prefer ILIKE for case-insensitive matches, and use upper() when attribute values are uppercase.

Examples:
• Single feature:
DWITHIN("shape", querySingle('massgis:GISDATA.LIBRARIES_PT','shape', 'upper("town") = ''ARLINGTON'' AND upper("address") = ''175 MASSACHUSETTS AVENUE'''), 50, meters)

• Multiple features via IN:
DWITHIN("shape", collectGeometries(queryCollection('massgis:GISDATA.LIBRARIES_PT','shape', '"libkey" IN (''PU-ARLINGTO-ROBBINS'',''OTHER'')')), 50, meters)

Workflow: search-layers → describe-schema → query-spatial → massmapper-link.

post.summary: Intersect features with a municipality boundary.
post.description: Convenience wrapper around query-spatial that automatically handles CRS and town polygons. Internally uses INTERSECTS with collectGeometries(queryCollection(...)) against the towns layer. Quote identifiers in filters and use upper() for uppercase attributes.

LAST RESORT. Use only when the user provides raw WGS‑84 coordinates. Returns features within a radius of lon/lat using DWITHIN; the server transforms coordinates to the layer's native CRS automatically.

If you are finding features near other features, do NOT use this; instead use query-spatial with the universal cross-layer pattern (queryCollection/querySingle).

post.summary: Fetch extended metadata for a layer.
post.description: Returns title, category, geometry type, and description text.

Generates an interactive URL pre‑loading the layers returned by previous spatial queries.

Workflow: Always call after spatial analysis to visualize results (can union bboxes across multiple municipalities). After completing all spatial queries across relevant layers, call massmapper_link with municipalities set from context and include_all_used=True; if you know the exact set, pass specific_layers=[...] explicitly.

municipalities.description: Municipalities to focus the map on.

include_all_used.description: Include every layer touched this session.
